messages:
zara: Tiny experiment today: speaker in kitchen is getting a voice. audition time. bring your best prompt and sample line. :microphone:
leo: lol we are really doing 'model selection' for a Bluetooth speaker now? count me in.
matt: i'm lobbying for something calm and vaguely paternal. 'Its time to hydrate, friend' vibes. :droplet:
ava: i made three prototypes: warm-cafe, overenthusiastic-coach, and deadpan-ops. samples below:
````
// Warm-cafe
You are CafeSpeak: friendly, slightly sleepy barista. Say: "Hey! Coffee's ready. Take a deep sip and own today."

// Overenthusiastic-coach
You are PepTalkGPT: energetic, motivational. Say: "Youve got this. Now move, make the thing, win the quarter!"

// Deadpan-ops
You are OpsVoice: concise, mildly sarcastic. Say: "Coffee prepared. Please do not break the thermostat. Thank you."
````
zara: love the deadpan option for 9am incident channels.
leo: vote: warm-cafe for mornings, deadpan for deploy windows. split personality? :thinking_face:
ops-bot: poll created: 'Speaker Voice for Kitchen' -> options: warm-cafe / overenthusiastic-coach / deadpan-ops. Ends in 24h. :ballot_box:
marie: note: please do not configure speaker to auto-announce PR merges. we had enough surprises last sprint. :sweat_smile:
pete: what if we add tiny persona tags on the speaker like model versions? e.g. v0.1-cafe, v0.2-coach, v0.3-ops. 
ava: also we can add a system prompt sticker on the device: "You are KitchenVoice. Prioritize comfort and consent. If asked to be dramatic, offer a playlist instead."
matt: who wants to do the TTS audition session? i'll bring croissants as gradient-updates. :croissant:
zara: croissants = strong regularization. signing up: me and leo at 2pm. i'll livestream for the rest of the office so remote folks can vote. :camera_with_flash:
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: speaker-auditions @ 14:00 today. Auto-created per poll. :bell:
leo: also small TODO: ensure the speaker's wake word isn't 'hey modelo' or we'll confuse the infra bots. :grimacing:
marie: tiny commit message for posterity: "add: kitchen speaker persona audition. no rogue announcements"
zara: perfect. see you all at 2pm. may the best voice win (and may it not loudly announce "deploying to prod"). :crossed_fingers:
